When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
